integrity: Explicit classification, realizability witnesses, finite-parameter verification program, and topological and Littlestone arguments supplied. The same-model review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to all inclusion-maximal pairwise-intersecting families of edges of a labeled complete graph on n >= 4 vertices. Higher uniformity is not covered; topological results for the full line-graph clique complex are previously known. Computations check finite parameters only; independent mathematical validation and exhaustive historical-priority audit have not been performed.
title: Exact shattering and online learning for maximal intersecting edge families
